eval_feedback.observation: Both copies satisfy all factual/length assertions while repeating scarce source facts. A repeats replaceability through most of the copy; B repeats the warranty.
eval_feedback.suggestion: Keep assertions unchanged for this evaluation. In future tests, assess the positive request to make copy more compelling separately from factual restraint, so compliant word-count padding is not mistaken for effective copy.
